comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body: 2026-10-17: not the tip box - a live one (Claude Code 2.1.301) reads idle with an empty prompt under main's and 0.16.0's rules, now recorded (1401a635, docs/observations/claude-code-2.1.301.md). 0.16.0 gave one reason, 'its screen is not its prompt', for three causes main tells apart (a box over the prompt, a screen reading at work, no prompt box found). Candidates: the feedback-draft box (main reads it), a title still showing the busy spinner after the turn (osc_title_working outranks live_prompt_box), or a rule drawn below the prompt box (the box is found as the second rule from the bottom). Since cd3e07bd, msg.ring.waits and msg.ring.covered carry the deciding rule and a text-free shape of the last 12 rows, so the next hold under a build with it names its cause; close this from that record.

comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body: 2026-10-17 13:03, a new lead (see a_2cP6w1lHN's newest comment): an idle Claude Code pane had a wake typed into its prompt that was never submitted, until its sender pressed Return for it ten minutes later, while Claude Code's 'Heads up' tip box showed above the prompt. The rules read the prompt under the box (1401a635), but whether the box takes the ring's Return is not established; the next sighting's msg.ring.* record (cd3e07bd) should say whether the ring was typed and its Return lost, or never rung.

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
2026-10-17, laptop, Muster 0.16.0 with its built-in claude.toml (the Oct 13 override had been removed): the integrator pane MUSTER (Claude Code 2.1.3xx, Opus) had worker messages held five times in one morning. The daemon log shows `msg.ring.waits` with reason "its screen is not its prompt" from the post until the stall watch spoke 2-5 minutes later (`msg.group.stalled` at 14:26:23, 14:44:23, 15:14:24, 15:17:54, 15:18:24 UTC), each time while the pane was idle at its prompt; the wake arrived only when something else made the pane redraw. The round lost those minutes on every worker report.

A capture of the same pane idle 30 s after a turn at 15:28 UTC read normally (state idle, prompt empty, done line '· 1 shell, 1 monitor still running', footer '⏵⏵ bypass permissions on · 1 shell, 1 monitor'), so the cause is something drawn only some of the time. Candidates, unconfirmed: Claude Code's feedback-draft box (main's `feedback_draft_box` rule reads it; 0.16.0 does not), and Claude Code's tip box ('✦ Heads up · ... 1: Learn more   2: Knew this already   0: Dismiss'), seen in worker panes the same morning and known to neither 0.16.0 nor main's manifest or corpus.

Next step: capture the screen at the moment a ring waits on this reason (the daemon could log the rows it judged, behind the debug flag, or a watcher could read the pane on `msg.ring.waits`), then record it into the detection corpus and decide whether the tip box covers the prompt.
title: Rings to an idle Claude Code pane wait minutes on 'its screen is not its prompt'
